source: Nuolja SITES 5var CSV, Clearsky CSV, AROME 21x21 cache
causality_requirement: Strict validation of source timestamps <= t
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError on hash or schema mismatch
Raise ModelGovernanceError on unparseable or non-UTC timestamp

causality_requirement: Target timestamps strictly > t (t+1 to t+24)
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError on incomplete horizon or NaN target

causality_requirement: Requires 24h lookback history and 24h target horizon
failure_behavior: Reject origin if history < 24h or target < 24h

input: MPC origin t, AROME issue index
output: Selected issue run t_issue = max(issue_time <= t)
causality_requirement: t_issue strictly <= t; future issue runs forbidden
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError if t_issue > t or no issue run exists

input: Origin t, issue t_issue, target horizon h
output: Effective lead index H_effective = h + (t - t_issue)
causality_requirement: Maps target t+h to valid lead in selected issue run
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError if H_effective exceeds max available lead
Raise ModelGovernanceError if any required feature is missing

causality_requirement: Chronological separation with mandatory 24h boundary embargo
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError if sample target window crosses split boundary

causality_requirement: Prevents 24h target leakage across Train/Val/Test boundaries
failure_behavior: Exclude origin from split if t+24h extends into next split

causality_requirement: Uses only inputs available at t
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError on missing historical observation

causality_requirement: Abstract base class enforcing fit/predict/save/load contract
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError if model not fitted

causality_requirement: Fitted STRICTLY on training set; zero test set leakage
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError if fit_transform called on test data

causality_requirement: Deterministic serialization with byte-level SHA-256 hash
failure_behavior: Raise ModelGovernanceError on serialization failure or hash mismatch
Raise ModelGovernanceError if any required provenance field is missing

causality_requirement: Separate Python process; loads model from disk (no in-memory objects)
failure_behavior: Set status NOT_REPRODUCIBLE and block EMS promotion on mismatch

causality_requirement: Pre-flight unit testing before training authorization
failure_behavior: Block training gate if any test fails
